sources.label: Programmes officiels — Ministère de l'Éducation
sources.rights: Official curriculum documents published by the Ministry of Education for public use. These specify what must be taught; the platform is built to follow them.

sources.label: Manuels scolaires — Centre National Pédagogique
sources.rights: CNP is the state textbook publisher and SELLS these books — the page is a sales catalogue (search form + /services-vente/), not a PDF library. There are no downloadable textbook files. Only catalogue metadata (which manual exists per level/subject) can be recorded. To distribute the books themselves you need a licence from CNP.

sources.label: Épreuves du Baccalauréat — BacWeb
sources.rights: Official Bac papers and corrigés published by the Ministry for revision.

sources.label: Concours 9ème année — 9Web
sources.rights: Official 9ème national exam papers published by the Ministry (edunet.tn).

sources.label: Concours 6ème année — 6Web
sources.rights: Official 6ème concours papers published by the Ministry (edunet.tn).

sources.label: Concours nationaux — ecoles.com.tn
sources.rights: Private aggregator, not a Ministry site — it republishes exams alongside its own material. Deep-link it; take the papers themselves from the official bacweb/9web/6web sources above.
